value.rationale: Direct mapping spaces between minimal finite models are the level at which finite-space homotopy and subdivision interact. The result gives a complete natural invariant for the canonical smallest circle source and a canonical minimal Klein-bottle target: not merely a count, but a decomposition into one Klein-bottle-type component, two circle-type components, and eight contractible components. This exposes structure invisible from target minimality or a raw map census and supplies a concrete benchmark for subdivision-based realization questions.
